Resolves #21566

🌿 *After this, the notes can no longer say the board is due Thursday, or that Sass builds the themes.*

Iteration 3 of `.github/RELEASE_NOTES/v14.0.0.md` adds the 241 pull requests merged between iteration 2's read (2026-11-16T02:20Z) and 2026-11-20T13:51Z. Two chapters are new: *The themes are plain CSS* and *A web desktop joins the engine*. Every other chapter is brought to `dev` at `5cb81df00a`. *Upgrading from 13.4.0* gains a table of four workspace changes and eleven behaviour rows, the outside-contributor table is rerun (87 merges from 46 accounts), and *Also in 14* gains the window's engine fixes.

Related: #21032

Evidence: L2 (the release-note guard specs; a live state read of every linked issue and pull request; each claim read against its pull request's diff, its issue or a measurement; a headless render of the note's Portal route) → L2 required (AC-1 to AC-7; a staging note has no deployed surface).
